component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 m.step = 0 m.scenario = "init" m.stealOnLeave = false m.stealDepth = 0
m.outlet = m.top.findNode("outlet") m.page = m.top.findNode("page") m.gridA = m.top.findNode("gridA") m.gridB = m.top.findNode("gridB") m.overhang = m.top.findNode("overhang") m.menuItem = m.top.findNode("menuItem")
m.outlet.observeField("focusedChild", "onOutletFocus") m.overhang.observeField("focusedChild", "onOverhangFocus")
p("init", "ready", fs())
m.stepTimer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.stepTimer.observeField("fire", "onStepTimer") m.stepTimer.control = "start" end sub
' ---------------------------------------------------------------- trace helpers
sub p(scenario as string, point as string, detail = "" as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 num = "00" + str(m.seq).trim() print "PROBE|" + Right(num, 3) + "|" + scenario + "|" + point + "|" + detail end sub
function b(value as boolean) as string if value then return "T" return "F" end function
' Reads a node's `focusedChild`. Roku's docs claim reading this field raises a script error, so ' the read is guarded - "<err>" in the trace is itself a finding. function fcId(node as object) as string result = "<err>" try fc = node.focusedChild if fc = invalid result = "invalid" else id = fc.id if id = "" then id = "<noid>" result = id end if catch e result = "<err>" end try return result end function
' The live focus state, printed with every record. function fs() as string return "gridA=" + b(m.gridA.hasFocus()) + " gridB=" + b(m.gridB.hasFocus()) + " menu=" + b(m.menuItem.hasFocus()) + " outletInChain=" + b(m.outlet.isInFocusChain()) + " outletFC=" + fcId(m.outlet) + " overhangFC=" + fcId(m.overhang) + " sceneFC=" + fcId(m.top) end function
' Renders an observer payload without assuming it is a node. function payload(event as object) as string result = "<err>" try data = event.getData() if data = invalid result = "invalid" else if type(data) = "roSGNode" id = data.id if id = "" then id = "<noid>" result = "node:" + id + ":" + data.subtype() else result = "type:" + type(data) end if catch e result = "<err>" end try return result end function
' ---------------------------------------------------------------- observers
sub onOutletFocus(event as object) p(m.scenario, "OBS-outlet", "data=" + payload(event) + " " + fs())
' The re-entrant steal: exactly what sgRouter does when focus leaves its outlet. if m.stealOnLeave and not m.outlet.isInFocusChain() and m.stealDepth = 0 m.stealDepth = 1 p(m.scenario, "OBS-outlet-steal", "calling gridA.setFocus(true)") m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "OBS-outlet-steal-done", fs()) m.stealDepth = 0 end if end sub
sub onOverhangFocus(event as object) p(m.scenario, "OBS-overhang", "data=" + payload(event) + " " + fs()) end sub
sub onDialogButton(event as object) p(m.scenario, "DIALOG-buttonSelected", "index=" + str(event.getData()).trim() + " " + fs()) m.top.dialog = invalid end sub
sub onDialogClosed(event as object) p(m.scenario, "DIALOG-wasClosed", fs()) end sub
' ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenario driver
sub onStepTimer() m.step = m.step + 1
if m.step = 1 m.scenario = "S1-enter" p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs())
else if m.step = 2 m.scenario = "S2-move-within" p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.gridB.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs())
else if m.step = 3 m.scenario = "S3-leave" p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.menuItem.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs())
else if m.step = 4 m.scenario = "S4-prep" p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs())
else if m.step = 5 m.scenario = "S4-steal" m.stealOnLeave = true p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.menuItem.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs()) m.stealOnLeave = false
else if m.step = 6 ' One settled frame after the steal: whoever actually owns focus should still own it. m.scenario = "S4-settled" p(m.scenario, "settled", fs())
else if m.step = 7 m.scenario = "S5-redundant" p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) ' gridB does not hold focus - unsetting it is a no-op write. m.gridB.setFocus(false) p(m.scenario, "after-unfocus-idle-node", fs()) ' Re-focus the node that already holds focus - a same-value write up the whole chain. if m.gridA.hasFocus() m.gridA.setFocus(true) else m.menuItem.setFocus(true) end if p(m.scenario, "after-refocus-same-node", fs())
else if m.step = 8 m.scenario = "S6-prep" p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after", fs())
else if m.step = 9 m.scenario = "S6-dialog" dlg = createObject("roSGNode", "StandardMessageDialog") dlg.title = "Focus Probe" dlg.message = ["Press DOWN then OK"] dlg.buttons = ["Cancel", "Exit"] dlg.observeField("buttonSelected", "onDialogButton") dlg.observeField("wasClosed", "onDialogClosed") m.dialog = dlg p(m.scenario, "before", fs()) m.top.dialog = dlg p(m.scenario, "after", fs())
else if m.step = 10 ' The dialog claims focus on its first render, so sample once the frame has settled. m.scenario = "S6-settled" p(m.scenario, "settled", "dialogInChain=" + b(m.dialog.isInFocusChain()) + " dialogHasFocus=" + b(m.dialog.hasFocus()) + " " + fs())
else if m.step = 11 m.scenario = "S7-modal" p(m.scenario, "before-steal", "dialogInChain=" + b(m.dialog.isInFocusChain()) + " " + fs()) m.gridA.setFocus(true) p(m.scenario, "after-steal", "dialogInChain=" + b(m.dialog.isInFocusChain()) + " " + fs()) m.stepTimer.control = "stop" print "PROBE|---|S7-modal|MANUAL|Now press DOWN, then OK, then BACK on the remote."
end if end sub
' ---------------------------------------------------------------- key trace ' ' The Scene is always in the focus chain, so this fires for any key the framework routes to the ' scene. While a dialog is visible it must NOT fire on a real device if dialogs are modal. function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if press p(m.scenario, "SCENE-onKeyEvent", "key=" + key + " " + fs()) end if if key = "back" and press p(m.scenario, "exit", "probe complete") m.top.probeExit = true return true end if return false end function
